mechanism: Establish one original clearly adult stylized character with at least three stable identity anchors in a held portrait that lasts long enough for one micro-action to matter. Replace the character once with a restrained brush or material mark carrying no more than one short exact phrase, then return to a wide environmental hold where weather or ambient motion continues but the adult waits. Release exactly one committed full-body action after the pause and let its path create a clean graphic bridge into a terminal emblem. End on a stable poster containing the unchanged full character, one original name and at most one short identity line. The reusable mechanism is held identity, micro-action, minimal brush-title anticipation, environmental waiting, single action release and emblematic poster closure—not the source woman, face, hair, robes, sword, words, title, ink circle, landscape, exact choreography, creator identity or timing.

invariants.rule: Hold one adult character portrait with three identity anchors until one micro-action becomes salient.
invariants.purpose: Builds attention through stillness rather than cut frequency.
invariants.ablation_failure: Immediate motion removes the retention contrast.

invariants.rule: Use one restrained material mark with no more than one short exact phrase.
invariants.purpose: Turns typography into anticipation instead of exposition.
invariants.ablation_failure: Dense copy breaks the pause rhythm.

invariants.rule: Return to a wide environment where ambient motion continues but the adult waits.
invariants.purpose: Transfers tension from face to world scale.
invariants.ablation_failure: Constant character action spends the stored energy too early.

invariants.rule: Release exactly one committed full-body action and settle immediately afterward.
invariants.purpose: Concentrates payoff into one readable event.
invariants.ablation_failure: Multiple attacks convert the mechanism into an action montage.

invariants.rule: Convert the settled identity into a stable poster with one name and at most one identity line.
invariants.purpose: Closes character and concept into a memorable emblem.
invariants.ablation_failure: Another narrative beat after the poster weakens closure.

slots.name: setting

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.
